description: Traffic and Pedestrian Signal Evaluations [BETA] is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This dataset is currently under construction and subject to change at any time. The records in this dataset do not reflect actual business records and have been created for demonstration purposes only. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are traffic signals, mobility, traffic, transportation. The table has 22 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
